All3899 regular Git blobs plus three explicit authored oracle/case/probe overlays are retained or recoverable by immutable Git object identity, with independent content/mode/population review and full before/after guards around all seven actual commands. This is a conservative supplied-input superset, not minimal observed IO. Gitlinks/non-regular entries are excluded by metadata without payload reads. Current existing Perl/spec/test bytes still match the immutable boundary; no production/test/spec/CI/dependency changes occur. The independent literal construction defines every expected raw, argument object and scalar interval without scanning producer outputs or searching equal text. Nine regex forms intentionally retain quoted syntactic matches; eleven statement forms retain the original splitter-selected statements. Within-contract source order is distinct from contract-precedence composition. Permanent original guards cover nested/callback/error/opaque/empty/source-authority behavior. Public/private value equality and actual original event/argument reference checks describe the inspected invocations; they do not imply cross-invocation reference identity. The initial wrong test-path driver retains original producer, immutable manifest and full actual prove channels/exit2, is explicitly incomplete and is never promoted. Only its test selection is corrected; the fresh complete run is separately captured. Book publication inputs and rendered HTML are a separate complete retained boundary. Necessary host OS/Perl/Python standard libraries and PATH-resolved prove/mdBook are read-only prerequisites; project data remains on the repository volume. Canonical recurrence and BasicRules parent closeout are separately owned by .1.1.2.1. Remaining producers, executable membership, comments, replacement, arbitrary host syntax, malicious callback mutation, native execution, backend/cross-host admission and global historical audit are outside this bounded proof.
